events.title: Gypsy Madness – Balkan Style: Swing Manouche / Hot Jazz Band Budapest
events.summary: Hot Jazz 2026–2027 presents a Gypsy Madness / Balkan Style program in Tel Aviv, billed around Budapest swing-manouche and Hungarian café-jazz traditions. The Gray Tel Aviv performance is listed for April 6, 2027 at 21:00.

events.title: zygo events
